prompts.name: 01-the-last-handhold
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one polished cinematic LANDSCAPE 16:9 cover illustration for the dark xianxia world Defy the Heavens. Match the world's authored art direction: smooth painterly illustrated xianxia, refined brushwork, clean contours, elegant believable anatomy, richly layered distressed silk, deep colour, controlled luminous spiritual light, beauty coexisting with cosmic dread. Illustration, not photography, not plastic CGI.
Core scene: ONE adult male Chinese cultivator, centered, physically crawling and clawing his way UP a steep broken cliff from a bottomless abyss toward the distant heavens. He is desperately struggling, not standing, flying, posing, or falling. One hand clenches a rock ledge; the other reaches for the next hold; bent knees and straining muscles establish upward movement. Countless ghostly hands of despair emerge organically from the darkness BELOW him, gripping his ankles, robe hem, waist and forearms and pulling DOWN. These are spectral hands, not extra limbs attached to him. Strong silhouette and readable anatomy: cultivator has exactly two arms and two legs. His wind-tangled black hair, torn dark layered silk robes, grit, wet eyes and clenched jaw express anguish, stubborn hope, exhaustion and fierce resolve. Minor scrapes only; no gore. Immense physical depth, vertiginous rock, ascending composition within a wide landscape canvas. No moon. No extra protagonist, monster, weapon, modern objects, UI, watermark or decorative frame.
Typography: Integrate only the exact prominent, beautifully legible title "DEFY THE HEAVENS", in elegant weathered monumental serif lettering with restrained brushed gold, cinematic book/game cover typography. Give text intentional clear negative space without obscuring face, reaching hand, or main body. No subtitle or other text.
Composition: a visceral medium-wide frontal three-quarter view looking slightly down along the cliff, protagonist centered and large enough to read his anguished face, chest close to stone. He looks UP toward a narrow white-gold opening high above frame center. The crag runs upward through the middle, countless hands spiral out of deep ink-indigo darkness beneath and around him. Muted jade, midnight blue and pale gold, rim-lit silk and chalk dust. Title across the upper clear cloud band. Emphasize one last brutally difficult handhold and emotionally intimate defiance.
